scope.hassanZoneNote: ICAR-CRIDA Hassan plan (p1) places Hassan mainly in the Southern Transition Zone (KA-7), with taluk blocks in Zone-4 (Central Dry), Zone-6 (Southern Dry) and Zone-9 (Hilly). The brief calls Hassan 'southern dry zone'; only the Zone-6 portion is southern dry. Neighbouring Southern Dry Zone district plans (Mysore, Mandya, Chamarajanagar) are recorded as region IN-KA with sourceDistrict, never as IN-KA-hassan.
scope.coimbatoreZoneNote: ICAR-CRIDA Coimbatore plan (p1): Western Zone (TN-3) and High Altitude and Hilly Zone (TN-7). TNAU 'Western Zone' rows naming Coimbatore are recorded as IN-TN-coimbatore; statewide TNAU rows are IN-TN.

methods.weekToDate: CRIDA 'Nth week' of a month converted as 1st=01-07, 2nd=08-14, 3rd=15-21, 4th=22-month end; '1st FN' (fortnight)=01-15; a month-only bound uses the 1st or last day of the month. Conversion is arithmetic, not a source value.
methods.seasonLabel: Source season label kept where the source gives one (CRIDA Kharif/Rabi/Summer rows). Otherwise assigned from the start month: Feb-Apr summer, May-Aug kharif, Sep-Jan rabi. TN pattam names are kept in notes.
methods.rotationRoleRule: Legumes with a cited BNF statement = nitrogen_fixer. Others derived from a cited per-hectare N uptake/removal at the source's stated yield or the cited recommended N dose: >=120 kg N/ha heavy_feeder, 60-119 moderate_feeder, <60 light_feeder. This threshold rule is a project analytic convention (rule v1), not a published classification; role is null when no cited N figure exists.
methods.stages: Day 0 = sowing or planting (FAO-56 notes the initial stage of transplanted crops starts at transplanting). FAO stage splits (Kc initial/development/mid/late) are used only where FAO publishes a row; the crop-specific source is used where one exists. FAO rows are not KA/TN cultivar phenology.
methods.dataCompleteness: Scored fields: family, productIds, rotationRole, nutrientUptake, waterNeedMm, rainfedSuitable, durationDays, stages, sowingWindows (any KA or TN), predecessors/successors (one field), avoidAfter, seasonalRisks; plus nitrogenCreditKgPerHa for legumes (13 fields) else 12. A field counts only if it carries a cited source. Family is counted from standard taxonomy with the botanical name taken from repo crop-profiles; not a retrieved document.

notes: All records are research candidates; no excerpt has been human-reviewed. Excerpts marked 'as recorded in repo' were not re-read from the original page in this pass.

nitrogenCreditKgPerHa uses one generic FAO statement (preceding legume reduces next-crop fertilizer N by 40-50 kg/ha, stated in the potato guideline) for all seven grain legumes. No crop-specific residual N credit from ICAR/TNAU/UAS was retrieved. Treat as a low-confidence scenario input, not a measured farm benefit.
nitrogenFixationKgPerHa (groundnut 110-150) is gross fixation, not residual credit; FAO inoculation benefits (chickpea, pigeon pea 20-25 kg N/ha) apply to the legume crop itself.
CRIDA district plans are dated 2011; sowing windows reflect that vintage. Hassan table 1.12 covers only paddy, ragi, maize, potato and sunflower; other Hassan crops have sequences but no window.
Generic CRIDA Mysore 'Pulses' Kharif-Rainfed window (April 2nd week to June 2nd week) is not attached to any single legume because the column does not name the pulse.

Erode (TN5) and Tiruppur (TN15) plans were downloaded and their table 1.12 read (maize, sorghum, paddy, groundnut, sugarcane, gingelly) but not encoded here because Coimbatore's own table already covers those crops.
Stage tables from FAO are Kc periods for water balance, not phenological stages for crop-care advice.
Region IDs: IN-KA with sourceDistrict means a neighbouring Karnataka district plan (Mysore, Mandya, Chamarajanagar), not Hassan.
